name: Civilization
what: Grow a tiny tribe into a great empire, one turn at a time.

fanProjects.name: Unciv
fanProjects.what: A free, small take on Civilization V for phones and computers. It uses none of the original's files.
howToPlay: Get it from the Google Play store, F-Droid, or GitHub for computers.
Start a small map against 2 computer players.

fanProjects.name: Freeciv
fanProjects.what: A free classic empire game inspired by the early Civilization games.
howToPlay: Download it from freeciv.org, or play in your browser on their site.

lovedFeatures: A tech tree to unlock new things
Explore a map with hidden tiles
extraFeatures: Win by science, culture or war
